result.instructions: Manage the local Trama through these tools. Read get_context/get_task_details before editing. Send only the fields you want to change; null removes optional metadata. Flow: the agent's queue is assignee=agent and status=todo; when you start, move the task to inProgress (the person sees you're working on it); log progress with add_task_message; when you deliver, fill in agent_summary and the branch/commit/PR references and move it to review, where it waits for the person. Never move a task to done unless asked. Plans, reports and other Markdown documents go in the project's notes folder (notes_folder in get_context) and are attached to the task with attach_document. Personal annotations are private and never accessible. The activity is a history, not a queue that starts agents. Git/PR tools only read; use external tools to run code or publish deliveries. Goals group a project's tasks toward one outcome: set goal_id on a task to count it toward one; concluding a goal is the person's decision. In workspace mode, list projects first and pass project_id to project operations.
